caption: ROUGE-1 metric for fine-tuning MBart and T5 models with adapters with different r with WikiHow dataset
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the ROUGE-1 metric values across varying values of log r for different model configurations. The x-axis is labeled "log r" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 8, with tick labels at 0, 2, 4, 6, and 8. The y-axis is labeled "ROUGE-1" and employs a linear scale range from 0 to 35, with tick marks appearing at 0, 15, 30, and 35. A red solid line with circle markers represents "T5 + LoRA", starting at 24.61 at r=0 and decreasing to 30.71 at r=8. A green solid line with circle markers, labeled "T5 + AdaLoRA", begins at 26.83 at r=0 and increases to 31.71 at r=8. A blue solid line with circle markers, labeled "MBart + LoRA", initiates at 13.19 at r=0, dips to a minimum of 5.13 at r=2, and rises to 30.14 at r=8. Finally, an orange solid line with circle markers, labeled "MBart + AdaLoRA", starts at 13.53 at r=0, decreases to a minimum of 11.11 at r=2, and increases to 29.98 at r=8.
